data.name: European Biochar Industry Consortium
data.description: The European Biochar Industry Consortium (EBI), now operating as Biochar Europe, is a non-profit trade association founded in 2019 that represents European biochar producers, equipment suppliers and stakeholders. It publishes annual European Biochar Market Reports, advocates for policy/regulation, and works to define the role of Biochar Carbon Removal (BCR) within EU CDR policy.
